item.text:
Refactored traversal into a first-class lazy iterator. [KmpMatchIterator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpMatchIterator.java:1) now owns the KMP scanning state for one text input, which removes the internal callback-style scan loop and gives the codebase a reusable primitive for one-shot, incremental consumption of matches.

[KmpPattern.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpPattern.java:10) now exposes `matchIteratorIn(...)`, and its higher-level methods (`analyzeIn`, `findFirstIn`, `countMatchesIn`, `occursIn`, `forEachMatchIn`) are built on that iterator instead of duplicating traversal logic. [KmpSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearch.java:5) mirrors this with `matchIterator(...)`, [KmpSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchDemo.java:1) now demonstrates iterator-based consumption, and [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:4) was extended to verify iterator behavior, null handling, and exhaustion semantics.
